name: Mohammed Osama Samir
title: Senior BIM Architect
headline: Every discipline. One clear model.
intro: I specialize in high-end residential projects across the GCC, delivering coordinated architectural models from Schematic Design through IFC.
about: My work connects Architecture, Structure, MEP, Landscape and Interior, resolving clashes early and keeping deliverables aligned with the BIM Execution Plan.

experience.title: Senior BIM Architect
points: Build and coordinate integrated BIM models across disciplines for each design stage.
Keep designs and submittals aligned with the BEP, municipal codes and client requirements.
Work with the Dubai design team on design and delivery issues.
Align drawings with project teams and sub-consultants, and coordinate code compliance with municipal engineers.

experience.title: Senior Projects Coordinator
points: Led and mentored junior architects through training and day-to-day guidance.
Reviewed submittals and followed up with clients and all disciplines.
Coordinated Architecture, Structure, MEP and Infrastructure drawings.
Managed schedules, action plans and progress reporting.

education: Bachelor of Architecture, 2018. Faculty of Fine Arts, Architecture Department. Helwan University, Zamalek, Cairo.
approach: Communication & teamwork. Leadership & responsibility. Critical thinking & problem solving. Detail-oriented & quality-focused.
